plugin.note: Demon boss. Demonbane melee is strong, Scorching bow solo bind is a major ranged method, and Tumeken's shadow supports the high-effort 5:0 magic method.

requirements: Complete Death Plateau and start Troll Stronghold up to defeating Dad, or use Ghommal's hilt to teleport to Trollheim.
Bring one rope for the first God Wars Dungeon entry.
70 Hitpoints is required to enter Zamorak's Fortress.
Zamorak killcount or an appropriate entry bypass is required for repeated boss room access.
mechanics: K'ril uses melee most often and magic less often; both are single-target.
His melee swipe can poison even through Protect from Melee.
If the target is praying Protect from Melee, K'ril can use Prayer Smash instead of a melee hit, dealing heavy damage and draining prayer. Spectral spirit shield reduces the prayer drain.
His magic attack is only used against players in melee range.
Bodyguards are Balfrug Kreeyath using magic, Tstanon Karlak using melee, and Zakl'n Gritch using ranged.
After K'ril dies, bodyguards retarget random players in the room.

methods.label: General strategy
methods.summary: Use high magic defence with Protect from Melee for melee-range kills, manage minion damage after K'ril dies, and use blood spells or sustain gear because bones to peaches does not work on ashes.
prayers: Protect from Melee for standard melee-range kills
Adjust prayers after K'ril dies based on which minions target the player
steps: Wear gear that can handle K'ril's melee threat while keeping strong magic defence.
Use Protect from Melee during typical melee-range kills.
After K'ril dies, identify which bodyguards are targeting each player.
Kill or control minions while keeping hitpoints high.
For solo sustain, stack Tstanon Karlak and Zakl'n Gritch when possible and use Blood Barrage.
In teams, consider Lunar support spells such as Boost Potion Share and Stat Restore Pot Share.
risks: Prayer Smash can punish Protect from Melee with large damage and prayer drain.
Bones to peaches cannot be used because K'ril and minions drop ashes.
notes: Ward of Arceuus and Death Charge are optional utility choices when not using Lunar spells.

methods.label: Solo Scorching bow bind
methods.summary: Use Scorching bow special attacks with Lightbearer to bind K'ril, kite counterclockwise, and avoid most direct boss damage for long solo trips.
recommendedFor: players with Scorching bow and Lightbearer
steps: Start each kill in the north-west corner of the room, far from Tstanon Karlak's spawn.
Use Scorching bow special attack to bind K'ril in place.
Treat one special attack bind as lasting six attacks total.
On the seventh attack, use Scorching bow special attack again to refresh the bind.
Move counterclockwise around the room while kiting K'ril and Tstanon Karlak.
With good gear and stats, rely on Lightbearer to sustain special attack energy.
After K'ril dies, kill Balfrug Kreeyath first.
Stack Tstanon Karlak and Zakl'n Gritch and heal with Blood Barrage.
fallbacks: Death Charge can replace Lightbearer special-energy sustain, but it requires the Arceuus spellbook.
If using Death Charge, Blood Barrage is unavailable, so bring Guthan's equipment, extra brews, or another healing plan.
risks: Missing the special attack refresh lets K'ril close distance.
Using Arceuus for Death Charge shortens trips because Blood Barrage healing is lost.
inventory: Blood Barrage runes for minion healing
Toxic blowpipe for special attacks if not relying fully on Scorching bow
Food and prayer restoration for mistakes or minion damage

methods.label: Solo Tumeken's shadow 5:0
methods.summary: Use Tumeken's shadow with the 5:0 method for very high solo DPS, avoiding all K'ril damage when performed correctly.
recommendedFor: players with Tumeken's shadow and strong magic gear
steps: Use a 5:0 movement and attack cycle with Tumeken's shadow.
Maintain tick-perfect timing and precise clicks to avoid taking K'ril damage.
Use a private instance when planning very long trips so supply drops do not despawn.
risks: This method is much more input-intensive than other solo methods.
Magic setups weaker than Tumeken's shadow are not recommended by the guide.

methods.label: Tank with Protect from Melee
methods.summary: Tank K'ril similarly to General Graardor, using strong defensive gear and timing attacks so K'ril hits as infrequently as possible.
steps: Bring a tank setup with high defensive bonuses.
Hit K'ril twice for every hit he lands to reduce incoming damage over time.
If using melee, expect K'ril to hit about every eight game ticks under this rhythm.
Use Vengeance where available to reflect some incoming damage.
Stay aware of Prayer Smash when using Protect from Melee.
risks: Prayer Smash plus bodyguard hits can create dangerous burst damage.
The tank may need antidote support because K'ril can poison.

methods.label: Defensive tank with Protect from Magic
methods.summary: Use Protect from Magic with very high melee and ranged defence to avoid Prayer Smash and neutralize Balfrug Kreeyath, accepting slower kills for safer tanking.
steps: Wear very high melee and ranged defence.
Use Protect from Magic so K'ril does not use Prayer Smash.
Let the defensive gear handle K'ril's melee attacks and Zakl'n Gritch's ranged pressure.
Use accuracy-focused glove and amulet choices because the defensive setup already covers armour slots.
risks: Trips and kills are slower than offensive tanking.
Using full Justiciar can give up Slayer helmet bonuses while on task.

methods.label: Team attacker
methods.summary: Attackers wait for the tank to tag K'ril, pray against the most dangerous minion for their setup, and avoid taking boss focus.
prayers: Melee attackers use Protect from Magic while not tanking.
Ranged attackers use Protect from Missiles while not tanking.
If K'ril focuses a melee attacker, switch to Protect from Magic.
If K'ril focuses a ranged attacker, switch to Protect from Melee.
steps: Stand near one of the altar-side corners before K'ril respawns.
Wait for the tank to hit K'ril before attacking.
Pray against the minion that threatens your combat style most.
Wear armour that covers the other minion styles.
Bring antidote++ for yourself and to help the tank if needed.
risks: If K'ril switches focus to an attacker, their gear may be poor for tanking him.
inventory: Special attack weapon if not using Arclight or Emberlight as the main weapon

styleOptions.label: Ranged
styleOptions.summary: Scorching bow is the headline ranged option because its special attack binds K'ril and extends trips.

styleOptions.label: Solo Melee
styleOptions.summary: Solo melee focuses on demonbane or strong stab weapons while wearing enough ranged/magic defence to survive minions and K'ril.

styleOptions.label: Melee Tank
styleOptions.summary: Tank setup prioritizes survival with high defence, optional Justiciar, and a defensive shield.

styleOptions.label: Melee
styleOptions.summary: Team melee attacker setup emphasizes offensive melee gear and defender-based damage.

styleOptions.label: Magic
styleOptions.summary: Magic is centered on Tumeken's shadow and the 5:0 method; weaker magic weapons are not recommended by the guide.
